svg.text: Matched 1 eV launch: rotating RF remains bounded while standing RF and RF-off escape
100 kTh; r0=1 mm; E⊥=1 eV; azimuth=π/4; phase=0; positive tangential velocity. RF-off exits at 18.069 RF; standing RF exits at 21.309 RF.
Right panel shows the RF-period averaged rotating trajectory through 10,000 RF periods.
